source: BAG via the PDOK WFS, retrieved 12 November 2026: sources/dsfl/bag-amersfoort-sport-verblijfsobjecten.json (the verblijfsobjecten) and sources/dsfl/bag-amersfoort-sport-panden.geojson (their panden), recorded in sources/sources.lock.json.
note: The question is ambiguous on purpose, as a citizen asks it. must: the panden with a verblijfsobject in use whose only gebruiksdoel is sportfunctie. Every other pand in the reference extract may be shown: mixed use, verblijfsobject gevormd or in verbouwing. A place on no pand of the extract, within tolerance_m, is invented, also a sports school that the BAG registers as bijeenkomstfunctie only. must holds woonplaats Amersfoort only. The extract also holds the panden of Hoogland and Hooglanderveen, the other woonplaatsen of gemeente Amersfoort, so a map of the gemeente invents nothing.
